body.message:
As your check-out date is scheduled for today, we are following up regarding the pending payment for the extension.

Regarding the rate increase, please note that the revised rates have been updated recently by the management. The same updated rates apply to all guests requesting an extension,

As we operate as a holiday home, our rates are not fixed and are subject to change based on the current market conditions.

Kindly confirm if you would like to proceed with the extension or if you will be checking out as scheduled.

Our team will also be available to assist you with the check-out process.

Thank you for your understanding.
